UploadSafetySidecarUrl.description: Base URL of the sidecar implementing the UploadSafety sidecar API (docs/sidecar-api.md), without a trailing path.

UploadSafetySidecarApiKey.description: Optional Bearer token sent as Authorization to the sidecar. Leave empty for a local sidecar with no auth.

UploadSafetyAutoScreen.description: Surfaces screened automatically: upload (core file uploads), avatar and banner (IntegratedProfiles). Set one to false to stop screening it automatically, e.g. when another extension calls the UploadSafety.UploadScreener service itself. Surfaces not listed are screened.

UploadSafetyBlockUnscreened.description: When true, uploads in formats the checks cannot screen (SVG, PDF, video, ...) are refused unless the uploader has the uploadsafety-upload-unscreened right or the format is in $wgUploadSafetyUnscreenedAllowed. When false, they are allowed unscreened.

UploadSafetyUnscreenedAllowed.description: MIME types anyone may upload even though they are not screened, e.g. [ "audio/*", "application/pdf" ]. A trailing /* matches a whole type. Only used when $wgUploadSafetyBlockUnscreened is true.

UploadSafetyChecks.description: Checks to run, as name => parameters. Setting this replaces the default entirely. nsfw: reject when the score is >= threshold. nudity_regions: reject when a region's score is >= the threshold for its label (labels left out of thresholds are ignored).

UploadSafetyMaxFrames.description: Maximum frames of an animated image the sidecar should analyse (distinct frames are sampled evenly beyond this). The sidecar may clamp it.

UploadSafetyFailClosed.description: When true, reject image uploads if the sidecar or any configured check is unavailable (unreachable, error, unsupported or invalid response). When false, allow those uploads (fail open).

UploadSafetyAlwaysReject.description: When true, reject every image upload without running any checks.

UploadSafetyDebug.description: When true, upload success and rejection UI (and the UploadSafety log group) include check scores and failure details.

UploadSafetyShowSidecarVersion.description: When true, Special:Version lists the sidecar and runtime versions from /v1/info (never its service or model names).
